# 3D asset sources

Imported on 2026-08-26 from Kenney's CC0 City Kit series.

## Roads

- Source: [City Kit (Roads)](https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads)
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0)
- Included here: 54 GLB road tiles under `roads/`
- Excluded: traffic signs, lights, utility poles, construction props, dumpsters,
  standalone bridge pillars, and other non-road props

## Buildings

- Source: [City Kit (Commercial)](https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial)
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0)
- Included here: 19 GLB building models under `buildings/`
- Included here: 16 simplified GLB LOD models under `buildings/lod/`
- Excluded: awnings, parasols, overhangs, and other standalone decoration props

Copies of the original license files are stored under `../../licenses/`.
Attribution is not required, but credit to Kenney is appreciated.
